text: Anyone who has the link downloads the customer's name, addresses and full order history: no login, and the file stays on the public site forever. An email forwarded or a link pasted in a chat exposes it. Breaks RQ2 (own data only, behind the session cookie).

When build_exports fails before it writes the outbox row (Netlify upload error, token expired), the export stays pending: no email to the customer and nothing beyond a line in the cron log, so RQ6 (customer told within 10 minutes, owners see it) does not hold.
The Netlify deploy token on the VPS can replace the whole website, not only /exports.
